subject: Acme Analytics — customer engagement week planning and calendar holds
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Planning our customer engagement week (Dec)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We’d like to lock in a customer engagement week the first week of December so our execs and product team can see Redwood in action and discuss Dedicated/private deployment options. A few constraints from our side:

- Our execs prefer afternoon times PST (13:00–17:00 PST) to accommodate their CET colleagues.
- We expect a mix: one onsite day in SF for the leadership walkthrough (Wed preferred), then 2 half-day virtual sessions.
- Security will want a short pre-call about network access and sample data handling.

Can you propose calendar holds (and an agenda outline) this week? Also flag any travel lead times for SF onsite (hotel recommendations, pickup).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Platform, Acme Analytics
pri...@acmeanalytics.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning our customer engagement week (Dec)

Priya — great to hear, thanks for the constraints. I can do the invites and holds; below is a proposed approach and what I’ll action if that works for you.

Proposed schedule (week of Dec 7):
- Mon 7 Dec: Hold (virtual) 13:00–15:00 PST — intro + roadmap alignment
- Wed 9 Dec: Onsite SF — 10:00–16:00 local (leadership walkthrough, lunch, demo stations)
- Thu 10 Dec: Virtual deep-dive (technical) 13:00–16:00 PST (split into two 90-min blocks)

Action items I’ll do if you confirm:
- Create calendar holds and separate invites for onsite day (room + AV request)
- Draft agenda and attach (agenda_draft.pdf) and a travel/checklist (travel_prep_checklist.xlsx)
- Open a 30-minute security pre-call slot (we’ll need your security contact)
- Share recommended hotels (5–10 min drive from Redwood office) and orgs to handle airport pickup

Logistics notes / constraints:
- We can run a hybrid setup for the onsite day. Please confirm expected in-room headcount (we’ll reserve a 20-person room but can scale).
- If attendees require corporate VPN to reach demo hosts, we’ll coordinate with your SEC team in the pre-call.

If that plan looks good, I’ll send holds by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: agenda_draft.pdf, travel_prep_checklist.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning our customer engagement week (Dec)

Quick follow-up from infra/ops perspective:

- AV/Hybrid: Recommend we run the demo cluster on an isolated VLAN and provide a jumpbox for Acme's team. For the onsite room we’ll bring two laptops (local demo + failover) and a Teams room link.
- Time splits: For the virtual days, please split sessions into 90-min blocks with 15-min breaks to suit CET participants.
- Headcount: Rachel, can you confirm expected onsite number? I’ll book a 20-person room provisionally.

Also tagging Jonas for CS runbook (I can forward once we confirm dates).

—Connor
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Planning our customer engagement week (Dec)

Thanks, Rachel and Connor — that schedule looks promising. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Onsite headcount: 12 people (4 execs, 6 product, 2 security) — 20-person room is fine.
- Security pre-call: available Wed 2 Dec at 14:00 CET / 05:00 PST (hoping that works) — contact is Amit Rao (amit.rao@acmeanalytics.com).
- Travel: execs will likely arrive Tue night (8 Dec) and depart Thu morning (11 Dec) — any preferred hotels you can recommend?

Please send the calendar holds in my timezone (CET) and include the Redwood team’s travel lead for booking approvals. We’ll also need the agenda link in our corporate drive.

Priya

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning our customer engagement week (Dec)

Priya — perfect, thanks for the headcount and Amit’s contact. I’m sending calendar holds now (and will label them with CET and PST times). Quick notes:

- Calendar holds: you should see 3 invites from me in CET/PST formats (Mon 7 Dec virtual; Wed 9 Dec onsite SF; Thu 10 Dec virtual deep-dive). I’ll include local start times for SF onsite.
- Hotels: recommended options are The Modern (15 min), Hotel Griffon (10 min), and Yerba Buena Suites (20 min). I’ll add links in the shared agenda doc.
- Security pre-call: scheduled Wed 2 Dec, 14:00 CET / 05:00 PST — invite sent to Amit.
- Travel bookings: we prefer to have confirmations by Mon 30 Nov (one-week lead) for exec travel approvals; if that slips, we’ll still support, but prices may increase.

I’ll also open a short internal planning thread for travel approvals and CS runbook; Connor please forward Jonas once the CS runbook draft is ready.

Thanks — invites incoming.

Rachel
Enterprise Account Lead | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
